question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The space or room that is at the top of a building or just below the main roof
solution:
The correct answer is: **Attic.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Attic"** refers to the space or room just below the main roof of a building, often used for storage. (अटारी)

 
 
• **Example: **They found old family albums stored in the attic.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dome **(गुम्बद): A rounded vault forming the roof of a building or structure.

 
 
• **Example:** The dome of the Taj Mahal is a magnificent sight.
 
 
 
• **Ceiling **(छत): The upper interior surface of a room.
 
 
• **Example:** The ceiling of the room was painted with stars.
 
 
 
• **Stairs** (सीढ़ियाँ): A set of steps leading from one floor of a building to another.
 
 
• **Example:** The old house had creaky wooden stairs.
